composition_method: benchmark_bp = interpolate_tenor(curve[d], years_to_maturity(d)) * 100 [public]; market_oas_bp = oas[in_force_band][d] [public, already bp] where in_force_band steps to the obligor's new band at asserted_at (see migration_transitions); idiosyncratic_bp = per-instrument band/seniority baseline + a small per-instrument draw + a mean-reverting AR(1) daily wiggle + an engineered divergence bump inside placed windows + an engineered anticipation ramp ahead of each migration, scaled by the real inter-band OAS gap [synthetic — engineered]; spread_bp = market_oas_bp + idiosyncratic_bp; yield_bp = benchmark_bp + spread_bp. years_to_maturity recomputed per observation date, never fixed at issuance.

divergence_windows.note: earliest-closing window; flagged for Task 6 to place a confirming downgrade well before WINDOW_END
